# The Kaifer Insurance Group

> A family owned and operated independent insurance agency in Cockeysville, Maryland, open since 1974 and run by its second generation. Short form: KIG. Specializing in Erie Insurance, and representing ten insurers in all.

## Contact
- Address: 120 Cockeysville Rd #100, Cockeysville, MD 21030
- Phone: (410) 584-7610
- Fax: (410) 584-7614
- Email: mark@kaiferinsurance.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=8676493269257691816
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/kaiferinsurance
- X: https://x.com/KaiferIns

## Service area
All of Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia and DC. Clients in Cockeysville, Parkville, Catonsville, Forest Hill and Baltimore.

## How they work
"We do not work for an insurance company; we work for you." "We work on your side when you have a loss and follow through to see that you get fair, prompt payment and service." For business owners, the agency offers appointments during off-business hours and on weekends.

## Insurers represented (10)
Erie Insurance (their specialty), The Hanover Insurance Group, GEICO, Progressive, Chubb, Wright Flood, AIC (Agency Insurance Company), Chesapeake Employers Insurance, American Collectors Insurance, Hagerty.

## Coverage
- Personal: auto, homeowners, renters, condominium, flood, personal umbrella, boat and marine, motorcycle, motor home and RV, ATV, collector car, valuable items, rental property, high net worth coverage.
- Business: business owners package, general liability, commercial property, commercial auto, workers' compensation, professional liability (E&O), commercial umbrella, cyber liability, builders' risk, contractor's general liability, restaurant and bar, hotel and motel, manufacturers, non-profit, surety bonds.
- Life: individual life, individual disability, final expense, fixed annuities.
- Policy service: file a claim, online billing and payments, auto ID card request, certificate of insurance request, policy change request, annual insurance review.

## Giving back
A chili cook-off for the Dawn Hill Fight Foundation. Chemo Comfies, a non-profit that makes fleece blankets for cancer patients, created by Dottie Pope. Support for H.O.P.E. (Help for Oncology Problems and Emotional Support). A donor to the Baltimore County 4-H Fair.
